name: cavemio-username
title: Username
description: A username picker with a penguin holding a sign: your name appears on it as you type; if it’s taken, its smug owner slides in hugging a sign with your name on it.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The field is a labelled username input; its hint says Available or Taken and its error says why a name won’t do. A status region announces availability and the claim.
- The penguins are decoration (aria-hidden). Their poses are illustrations shipped inside handle-art.ts as WebP data URIs (37KB of images), with each sign’s position and tilt measured so the name is written on it in code.
- The scene is drawn at 364 × 176 and scaled to the stage; the owner slides in with a transform.
- With reduced motion the poses and the owner change in place.
- Built from Input, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: check
props.type: (name: string, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<{ available: boolean; suggestions?: string[] }>
props.description: – · Is the name free? Called 380ms after typing stops; aborted when a newer name starts.

props.name: onClaim
props.description: – · Keep the name. Throw an Error to show its message.

props.name: minLength / maxLength
props.description: 3 / 20 · The length range, said in the line under the title.

props.name: pattern / patternHint
props.description: /^[a-z0-9_]+$/ / "Letters, numbers and _ only." · What the whole name may contain, and what to say when it doesn’t.

props.name: prefix
props.description: "@" · Shown in the field and on the signs; use your domain for workspace URLs.

props.name: defaultValue / title / name
props.description: "" / "Pick a username" / "Handle" · A starting name, the heading, and the penguin’s name in his lines.

features.title: Checked as you type
features.description: check runs 380ms after typing stops; a newer name aborts the older request.

features.title: Rules said plainly
features.description: Lowercase as you type; too short, too long or a character that isn’t allowed says so before any check.

features.title: Something to try
features.description: When a name is taken, the suggestions your check returns are one-tap chips.

features.title: Your prefix
features.description: prefix shows @, or your domain for workspace URLs.

features.title: Claim with states
features.description: Claim @name → Claiming → Claimed, or the server’s reason under the field.

features.title: A check that failed
features.description: If check throws, the field says it couldn’t check instead of guessing.

states.title: empty
states.description: Handle holds up a sign with just “@”; “Handle will hold it up”.

states.title: typing
states.description: The name appears on his sign as you type (letters rise in through Text morph), shrinking to fit longer names; “Handle is asking around” while the check runs.

states.title: free
states.description: He beams (pose crossfade, 220ms), a green tick springs onto the sign’s corner, the hint says Available and Claim @name lights up.

states.title: taken
states.description: His sign goes blank and his face falls; the owner slides in from the right (520ms) hugging a sign with the name; “@ana is mine.” Suggestions rise in under the field, 50ms apart.

states.title: not allowed
states.description: A character outside the pattern: he looks lost, and the field shows the hint (“Letters, numbers and _ only.”) with no check.

states.title: claimed
states.description: Claim → Claiming → Claimed with a drawn check; “Hello, @ana”. If onClaim throws, the message shows under the field.
